{{Nihongo|Hardy|バドッグ|Badoggu}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].''

Hardy works as a doctor for the residents of [[Forget-Me-Not Valley]]. His house is located in the main strip of houses, just south of the farm. He's proud of his work, and never misses an appointment. He's been [[Romana (DS)|Romana]]'s doctor for years, but will happily help others in the valley if they need assistance.

He spends most of his time at home or at the spring. On Saturdays, he goes to see Romana for her weekly checkup at the mansion. After his visit with her, he will go to visit Galen and Nina at their home.

He will tell you (or your wife) that you are expecting a child after you get married. He and Nina will assist in the birth of your child.
